# IRREVERSIBLE ACTION PRE-VERIFICATION GATE (compose move payload)
print("Task: Move all sofas from my amazon cart to wish list.")

# Source cart sofa items already determined in previous cell.
cart_items = cart.get('cart_items', [])
sofa_items = [item for item in cart_items if 'sofa' in item.get('product_name','').lower()]

move_payload = []
for item in sofa_items:
    move_payload.append({
        'product_id': item['product_id'],
        'quantity': int(item.get('quantity', 1)),
        'source_product_name': item['product_name']
    })

# Current wish list state (for already-in-wishlist avoidance)
wishlist = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=access_token)
wishlist_ids = {w['product_id'] for w in wishlist}

target_moves = [p for p in move_payload if p['product_id'] not in wishlist_ids]
already_in_wish_list = [p for p in move_payload if p['product_id'] in wishlist_ids]

print('\nTarget move payload:')
for p in target_moves:
    print(p)

print('\nAlready in wishlist (should be empty for target_moves):')
for p in already_in_wish_list:
    print(p)

print('\nTarget moves count:', len(target_moves))

# Verification table mapping derived data back to cart
print('\nVerification table (Cart -> Move Payload):')
for p in target_moves:
    # find matching cart item
    src = next(i for i in sofa_items if i['product_id']==p['product_id'])
    print(f"product_id={p['product_id']} | cart_name={src['product_name']} | move_quantity={p['quantity']}")

# Execute moves: move each sofa product from cart to wish list
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Recompute target moves from current cart state to avoid stale state
cart_now = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)
sofa_items_now = [item for item in cart_now.get('cart_items', []) if 'sofa' in item.get('product_name','').lower()]

wishlist_now = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=access_token)
wishlist_ids_now = {w['product_id'] for w in wishlist_now}

moves = []
for item in sofa_items_now:
    pid = item['product_id']
    if pid not in wishlist_ids_now:
        moves.append({'product_id': pid, 'quantity': int(item.get('quantity', 1)), 'name': item.get('product_name')})

print('Moves to execute:', moves)

results = []
for m in moves:
    try:
        r = apis.amazon.move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list(product_id=m['product_id'], access_token=access_token, quantity=m['quantity'])
        results.append({'product_id': m['product_id'], 'ok': True, 'response': r})
    except Exception as e:
        results.append({'product_id': m['product_id'], 'ok': False, 'error': str(e)})

print('\nMove results:')
for res in results:
    print(res)

# Post-verify wish list and cart
wishlist_after = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=access_token)
cart_after = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)

wish_sos = [w for w in wishlist_after if 'sofa' in w.get('product_name','').lower()]
cart_sos = [i for i in cart_after.get('cart_items', []) if 'sofa' in i.get('product_name','').lower()]

print('\nWishlist sofa items after move:')
for w in wish_sos:
    print({'product_id': w['product_id'], 'name': w['product_name'], 'quantity': w.get('quantity')})

print('\nCart sofa items after move:')
for i in cart_sos:
    print({'product_id': i['product_id'], 'name': i['product_name'], 'quantity': i.get('quantity')})

print('\nCounts: wishlist sofa=', len(wish_sos), 'cart sofa=', len(cart_sos))

# Pre-completion gate: list explored endpoints and whether called
explored_called = [
    'amazon.login',
    'amazon.show_cart',
    'amazon.show_wish_list',
    'amazon.move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list'
]
print('Explored & called endpoints:', explored_called)
print('All sofa move operations completed successfully if cart sofa count=0.')
